description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git pack-redundant' command. It includes setup routines, test cases, and utility functions for creating commits and packs within Git repositories, and verifies the behavior of the pack-redundant tool in various scenarios involving redundant Git packs.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified Git repository with given names and sets shell variables to commit OIDs.

methods.name: create_pack_in
methods.description: Creates a pack in a specified Git repository and assigns its ID to a variable.

methods.name: format_packfiles
methods.description: Formats packfile filenames extracted from the output of 'git pack-objects'.
